days.title: Southern Village and Mineral Shores
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Djúpivogur
stops.detail: It extends from the fishing village of Djúpivogur in a northwesterly direction inland.

stops.name: Teigarhorn
stops.detail: At its feet at the so-called Teigarhorn lies an important site for various minerals such as calcite (also "Iceland spar"), which is known in optics for its double refraction and was mined here for this reason.

stops.name: Teigarhorn-Hof
stops.detail: The "Teigarhorn-Hof" of the Weywadt family is also located at Teigarhorn, where Nicoline Weywadt, the first Icelandic woman to work as a photographer, lived.

stops.name: Breiðdalsvulkan
stops.detail: On the eastern shore are the remains of the large tertiary Breiðdalsvulkan volcano, whose vents are clearly visible in good weather.

stops.name: Berunes
stops.detail: The Berunes youth hostel is located in the former residence on the eastern shore of the fjord.
